Container.Name: deedup
Container.Overview: deedup: dedupe your hoard, safely. Finds duplicate files across your Unraid disks by content, whatever their names, and photos that differ only in their metadata. Read-only by default: to let it move duplicates to a quarantine or apply your plans, set /mnt to read/write and turn on changes in its Setup screen.

Config.Name: Disks and shares
Config.Description: Host /mnt. Read-only by default. Set it to Read/Write - Slave only if you want deedup to remove duplicates or apply plans (also turn on changes in its Setup screen).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Index database. Put it on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on basic auth for the web UI (user name: deedup).
